title: Charlie Elegant Bed – Panel Headboard Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Charlie Elegant Bed is a versatile panel upholstered bed frame that looks equally at home in a modern or traditional bedroom. Refined contours and clean panel detailing give it a timeless look, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Elegant panel headboard with refined contours
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Solid timber slatted base
  • Available in all five UK bed sizes
  • Free fabric swatches before you buy

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £331.99; Double (4FT6) £350.99; King (5FT) £376.99; Super King (6FT) £435.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Will the Charlie Bed suit a traditional room?

Yes. Its refined contours and clean panels are designed to work in both modern and traditional bedrooms.

Where is the Charlie Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid wood frame.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
